en: Sepia-toned photograph showing a narrow street leading toward a large medieval stone gate flanked by two massive round towers with crenellations and machicolations. People in early-20th‑century clothing walk along the street; a bicycle is leaning against a wall. Above the arched passage of the gate there is a decorative panel with coats of arms or reliefs. The lower margin of the card shows a circular logo at left and a URL-like text at center.
